title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
notes: claim 77: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing, default, rollout information and documented controls are supported. Remove the unsupported assurance that users elsewhere are unaffected, and narrow the checklist's Loop instruction to the control its table actually provides.

claims.claim: The in-person setup steps on the Facilitator in Teams Rooms page name no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms in-person setup Microsoft 365 Copilot license meter. Opened the Rooms article; its in-person setup lists Teams Rooms Pro, not a Copilot licence. The scheduled-meeting section is separate.

claims.claim: The in-person setup steps on the Facilitator in Teams Rooms page name no meter.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms in-person setup Microsoft 365 Copilot license meter. Read the article's complete in-person setup steps and preview note; they name no meter.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms licences article states no price for Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-licensing Teams Rooms Pro price. Opened and read Microsoft Teams Rooms licenses, including comparison and purchasing sections; no Pro price is stated. Basic's no-additional-cost statement is separate.

claims.claim: The licensing article recognizes an Android device and connected touch console as a Teams Rooms system.
claims.quote: A Teams Rooms on Android device and touch console connected via either an IP-based or USB connection

claims.claim: The Take notes control is at Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the portal's Take notes button setting at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms "Show Take notes" API PowerShell Graph; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Teams Rooms Pro Management "Take notes"; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Teams Rooms device configuration Facilitator note taking. Read Rooms Facilitator and pro-portal-settings; no matching call.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Show Take notes button on the home screen is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.claim: Learn's setup step for the portal note-taking setting does not name a platform.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms "Show Take notes" API PowerShell Graph. Opened Facilitator in Microsoft Teams Rooms and read Step 4: Turn on note-taking for Teams Rooms. The setting's step gives no Windows or Android qualifier; the FAQ separately discusses availability.

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is controlled at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the specified meeting policy.
claims.quote: To manage meeting transcription using PowerShell, use the -AllowTranscription parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The transcription row describes a general user meeting policy, to which the Rooms setup steps refer.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify which meeting policy the resource account's in-person notes use.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator in-person transcription policy resource account which policy. Read Rooms Facilitator setup and meeting-transcription-captions; reviewed copilot-admin-mtr search passages. They describe general policies but name no policy identity for this in-person session.

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for the IsLoopEnabled Teams Loop components control.
claims.quote: Searched: Loop IsLoopEnabled admin center UI enable Teams components. Opened loop-admin-configuration, including its policy-tool table and Teams settings section. It gives SharePoint PowerShell for IsLoopEnabled, not a UI; its Cloud Policy UI controls other integrations.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled is a tenant-wide SharePoint organization property controlling Loop creation and integration in Teams.
claims.quote: IsLoopEnabled (boolean) | This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is a tenant-wide SharePoint property controlling collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled (boolean) | This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The collaborative meeting notes SharePoint property does not apply to Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: The Loop article covers Teams New Calendar configuration under Cloud Policy.
claims.quote: Loop components in Outlook, OneNote, Whiteboard, Teams New Calendar | Cloud Policy | Create and view Loop files in Microsoft apps that support Loop

claims.claim: The Pro Management portal settings article covers Teams Rooms on Android devices in general.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones)

claims.claim: The general Facilitator setup article says Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Facilitator is blocked if all apps are blocked for the organization.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: The Facilitator article provides Teams admin center steps to allow or block the app.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator. Select Facilitator from the app list. In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Learn lists sensitivity-label limitations for Facilitator in meetings elsewhere.
claims.quote: AI-generated notes for meetings don't inherit the meeting's sensitivity label; however, a sensitivity label can be applied to the notes' Loop component in the Loop app or OneDrive.

claims.claim: Learn lists an eDiscovery limitation for Facilitator notes in meetings elsewhere.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.

claims.claim: The Facilitator in Teams Rooms article does not state whether the separately listed meetings limitations apply to in-person room notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms in person notes sensitivity labels eDiscovery compliance. Read the full Rooms article and general Facilitator limitations; reviewed Purview search passages. The Rooms article gives no sensitivity-label or eDiscovery limitation mapping.

claims.claim: Users elsewhere are not affected.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person Teams Rooms notes participants outside room access work accounts. Read Rooms Facilitator and MC1307888. They identify the room-device audience and explain later access, but neither establishes that all users elsewhere are unaffected.
claims.fix: Remove '; users elsewhere are not affected' from the impact rationale. End the preceding sentence after 'touch board'.

claims.claim: After the prerequisites are met, room participants see a note-taking entry point on the console.
claims.quote: After you complete the required steps and meet the prerequisites, in-room participants will see a Facilitator icon on the front-of-room display and a "Tap to take notes" entry point on the console.

claims.claim: The checklist directs readers to the Loop row to check both IsLoopEnabled and IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled, but only the former has its own control row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Check IsLoopEnabled and IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled are on, using the Loop row below.' Row: 'Loop components in Teams (IsLoopEnabled)' with 'Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true'; IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is mentioned only in the note.
claims.fix: Replace that checklist bullet with 'Check IsLoopEnabled is on, using the Loop row below.' Keep the separately supported Message Center prerequisite about IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled elsewhere unchanged.

claims.claim: The roadmap says the feature is available with Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.claim: MC1307888 asks administrators to confirm Teams Rooms Pro licences are assigned to applicable rooms.
claims.quote: Confirm Teams Rooms Pro licenses are assigned to applicable rooms.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms licences article lists the services and features included in Basic and Pro.
claims.quote: The following table shows the services included in each Teams Rooms license. The following tables compare the Teams Rooms Basic and Teams Rooms Pro licenses and show what features are available with each.
